topic: Capstone Model Integration and API Testing
learningObjectives: Integrate a trained machine learning model into an API.
Understand request and response structures for predictions.
Identify common API and model integration errors.

activities.title: Understand Prediction Requests
activities.instruction: Inspect each request component to reveal its role.

content.concept: Prediction APIs receive structured input features and return model-generated results.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Build the Prediction API
activities.instruction: Assemble the API request and prediction flow.

content.concept: Model-serving APIs connect client requests to preprocessing, inference, and prediction responses.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Match API Errors
activities.instruction: Match each error with its likely cause.

content.concept: Invalid input, incorrect feature shapes, missing models, and server errors can break prediction APIs.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Test the Endpoint
activities.instruction: Select the valid test request for each scenario.

content.concept: API testing verifies input validation, prediction behavior, response structure, and error handling.
